{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.70

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Collects all loaded [[magazines]] from all [[secondaryWeapon]] muzzles and returns them in [[Array]], otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

|s1= [[secondaryWeaponMagazine]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>hint str secondaryWeaponMagazine player; //["NLAW_F"]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_array = secondaryWeaponMagazine player;
if (count _array > 0) then {
	hint ("Secondary weapon is loaded with " + (_array select 0) + "!");
} else {
	if (secondaryWeapon player != "") then {
		hint "Secondary weapon is not loaded!";
	} else {
		hint "Player doesn't have a secondary weapon!";
	};
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[secondaryWeapon]] [[secondaryWeaponItems]] [[addSecondaryWeaponItem]] [[primaryWeaponMagazine]] [[handgunMagazine]] [[binocularMagazine]]
}}
